Title: Attempt to add a shop with a phone number already registered as a customer
Preconditions: User is logged in as an ADMIN. A customer account exists with phone number '1234567890'.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Add New Shop' screen. 2. Enter valid shop details (e.g., shop name, address, area ID). 3. Enter the phone number '1234567890' in the 'Shop Phone' field. 4. Click the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Shop Name: 'Test Shop', Address: '123 Test St', Area ID: 1, Shop Phone: '1234567890'
Expected Result: The system should display an error message: 'This Phone Number is Registered as Customer' and prevent the shop from being created.

Title: Attempt to add a shop with a non-existent area ID
Preconditions: User is logged in as an ADMIN.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Add New Shop' screen. 2. Enter valid shop details (e.g., shop name, address, phone number). 3. Enter a non-existent area ID (e.g., 99999) in the 'Area ID' field. 4. Click the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Shop Name: 'Test Shop', Address: '123 Test St', Area ID: 99999, Shop Phone: '9876543210'
